scenarios.title: Public page head with no GA configured stays clean (0 gtag scripts, correct title)
scenarios.evidence: eval: {gtag:0, headLen:1597, scripts:2, title:'Smoke 568'}; server log has 0 analytics_head_resolution_failed entries

scenarios.title: GA4 measurement id configured through admin Settings->Integrations injects gtag script + inline init into public head
scenarios.evidence: eval: {gtmSrc:1, gtagInline:1, hasId:true, srcs:['https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-TEST568ABC']}; DB integration google-analytics connected with measurementId

scenarios.title: Removing the GA integration makes the head fail closed (tag disappears, no stale config)
scenarios.evidence: eval: {gtagScripts:0, hasId:false}; DB config cleared before render

scenarios.title: Import without maintenance mode is rejected fail-closed (409, no DB change)
scenarios.evidence: UI toast 'Enable maintenance mode before importing a backup.'; console 409 Conflict on /admin/api/backups/import

scenarios.title: Valid .cbk (22 tables, 0 rows) imports fully with maintenance mode on: decrypt->validate->tx->media
scenarios.evidence: UI toast 'Import complete: 22 tables, 0 rows.'; DB pages/media replaced per contract

scenarios.title: Archive missing one required table member is rejected with backup_manifest_invalid (422) before any mutation
scenarios.evidence: UI toast 'Backup manifest is missing or malformed.'; console 422; omitted postTermAssignments member from otherwise valid archive

scenarios.title: After import replaces content, public front serves 404 (no stale cached page)
scenarios.evidence: curl front /smoke-568 -> 404 after import (page no longer exists), not stale cached HTML
